behaviors.description: Acquire a granted session-bus name and observe controlled traffic logging from an app sandbox.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed app/runtime, private bus and echo service.
behaviors.expected: The own-name grant obtains the otherwise denied name; logged successful echo calls identify the method and destination while quiet controls do not.

behaviors.description: Acquire a granted system-bus name and observe traffic logging against a private redirected bus.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed app/runtime, private system-bus substitute and echo service.
behaviors.expected: The system-own-name grant obtains the otherwise denied name; logged successful echo calls identify the method and destination while quiet controls do not.

mappings.rationale: Live RequestName results establish ownership rather than serialized policy; quiet/logged/quiet echo calls isolate logging.

surface_assertions.rationale: The grant obtains PRIMARY_OWNER for a name otherwise rejected by the proxy.
The controlled method and destination appear only when traffic logging is enabled.

mappings.rationale: Ownership and logged calls traverse the system-bus proxy to a private bus, without host system-service access.

surface_assertions.rationale: The grant obtains PRIMARY_OWNER for a name otherwise rejected by the proxy.
The controlled method and destination appear only when system-bus logging is enabled.
